public_body: Northeast Metropolitan Regional Vocational School Building Committee
overall: The AG found the building committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged: no quorum communication was shown, the superintendent-authority issue is outside the OML, and document complaints fall under the Public Records Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that after a May 2023 meeting, several consequential decisions on the new school building were made outside a posted meeting, without the full committee.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find no deliberation because there was no communication “between or among a quorum” of the Committee.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Superintendent, a committee member, effectively made decisions that the full committee should have made.
allegations.key_passage: this allegation goes to the authority of individuals such as the Superintendent versus the Committee to take action on particular matters, which is not a matter governed by the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee did not provide documents or answer questions.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, failure to provide documents other than meeting minutes concerns a potential violation of the Public Records Law, but does not violate the Open Meeting Law.
